def test_reset_checks_effective_connection_before_stopping(tmp_path):
    conn = connection_loader.get('ssh', PlayContext(), StringIO())
    conn.host = 'example.org'
    conn.set_options(direct={'ssh_executable': '/tmp/custom-ssh', 'ssh_extra_args': '-o ForwardAgent=yes',
                             'control_path_dir': str(tmp_path)})
    socket = tmp_path / 'socket'
    socket.touch()
    conn.set_option('control_path', '%(directory)s/socket')
    with patch('ansible.plugins.connection.ssh.subprocess.Popen') as popen:
        popen.return_value.communicate.return_value = (b'', b'')
        popen.return_value.wait.return_value = 0
        conn.reset()
    assert popen.call_count == 2
    check, stop = [call[0][0] for call in popen.call_args_list]
    assert check[0] == stop[0] == b'/tmp/custom-ssh'
    assert b'ForwardAgent=yes' in check and b'ForwardAgent=yes' in stop
    assert check[-3:-1] == [b'-O', b'check']
    assert stop[-3:-1] == [b'-O', b'stop']
EOF
